title: Worktree preflight and docs validation tier
summary: This iteration separates day-to-day branch hygiene checks from publish-only preflight checks. The new worktree preflight command reports branch freshness, dirty state, upstream state, sibling main worktree ownership, and GitHub CLI auth observations as JSON, while validate:docs adds a lighter documentation/process gate without weakening the full npm run validate release gate.

lessons.lesson: Feature-branch readiness should not reuse publish-only checks that assume main is checked out and ready to push.
lessons.evidence: publish:preflight remains scoped to publishing, while preflight:worktree now checks origin/main ancestry, detached HEAD, dirty files, upstream state, sibling worktrees, and GitHub CLI auth as a separate JSON contract.
lessons.recommended_action: Run preflight:worktree before PR and merge-follow-up work, and keep publish:preflight reserved for publishing paths.

lessons.lesson: Documentation-only changes need a durable fast gate, but the full gate must remain authoritative before shipping.
lessons.evidence: validate:docs runs harness, retrospective, privacy, and whitespace checks; npm run validate still runs the broader content, source, unit, build, privacy, and browser checks.
lessons.recommended_action: Use validate:docs for quick docs/process feedback and npm run validate for final delivery.

followups.action: After this branch is merged, run preflight:worktree on the next fresh task branch to confirm it catches stale origin/main and token-environment warnings before implementation starts.
